brief:
An Israeli official stated that an extra team of pilots was aboard the aircraft, according to Maan Wire. The remarks came in reference to a plane that was shot down, though additional details about the incident remain unclear from the official's statement.

The disclosure about the supplementary crew suggests the aircraft may have carried more personnel than a standard flight configuration, though the circumstances surrounding the downing and the operational significance of the additional pilots were not elaborated.
title: Israel says additional pilot crew was aboard downed plane
